characters.name: Minh
characters.description: Vietnamese man, 30 years old, short black hair, wearing a dark coat, thoughtful expression

characters.name: Lan
characters.description: Vietnamese woman, 25 years old, long black hair, wearing a white sweater, warm smile

scenes.setting: A cozy small coffee shop with warm lighting, rain falling outside the window, afternoon
scenes.camera: Medium shot, slowly zooming in on the two characters sitting at a table

dialogues.text: Em có nhớ lần đầu chúng mình gặp nhau không?
dialogues.action: looking out the window, holding a coffee cup

dialogues.text: Nhớ chứ. Hôm đó trời cũng mưa như thế này.

scenes.setting: Flashback: An autumn park with golden leaves falling, warm sunlight filtering through trees
scenes.camera: Wide shot transitioning to close-up of the two characters meeting for the first time

narration.text: Đó là một ngày thu, khi những chiếc lá cuối cùng rơi xuống. Hai người xa lạ tình cờ gặp nhau trên con đường nhỏ.

scenes.background_music: gentle acoustic guitar, ambient autumn sounds
